title: F2: Claude dispatch requeues instead of holding when no account has headroom or Claude workers are at the cap
spec:
Goal T-1375. orchestrator/executor.py _exhausted (executor.py:545): a Claude dispatch (routed claude:<tier> row, or fallback with a tier) holds the task when pool.pick("execute") is None (executor.py:554-559), and the daemon auto-retries only budget holds, so the task strands. [limits].max_parallel_claude_workers is also not enforced for routed Claude executes.
Change _exhausted:
1. Keep today's hold for the policy case: not routed and tier is None (on_exhausted = hold, or complexity >= 9) -> unchanged held with the codex-unavailable reason.
2. When a tier is set (routed or fallback): compute running = daemon.running_claude_workers(pool) (lazy `from . import daemon` inside the function to avoid an import cycle) and cap = pool.cfg.get("limits", {}).get("max_parallel_claude_workers", 4). If acct is None or running >= cap: requeue exactly like the budget path in start() (executor.py:500-506): pipeline = dict(t.get("pipeline") or {}); pipeline["hold_note"] = "claude_capacity"; pipeline.pop("dispatched_at", None); bus.update(t["id"], status="queued", pipeline=pipeline); return {"status": "claude_capacity", "reason": "no account with headroom" if acct is None else "claude workers at cap"}. Do not hold.
3. Otherwise unchanged (dispatch).
start() already returns _exhausted's result with handed_off False when status != "fallback", so its finally releases the reservation; keep that.
Tests (unittest.TestCase methods in tests/test_executor.py): routed row with no headroom -> task queued with hold_note claude_capacity and dispatched_at removed, not held; fallback tier with running Claude workers at the cap -> same requeue; complexity 9 fallback -> still held with the codex-unavailable reason; headroom and below cap -> dispatches as before. Update any existing test that asserted the old "no account with headroom" hold (test_routed_claude_row_holds_without_headroom) to the requeue behaviour.
